acceptance.detail: T-0124 P1-01/02 resolved with complete real row/chunk functions: own empty output has 20 missing rows and exit1; fourth participant has one track defect and exit1. Ordinary counterexamples expose no foreign IDs. However the broader no-foreign-ID contract is unresolved: free reason text leaks a foreign ID (RECHECK-P1-02).

160 deterministic boundary cases preserve reasons/reasonsDetail projection and track exclusion. State-only clean chunk yields track out.size=0, agree pairs=0 and all 40 HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED. But ownership swaps give chunk defect sum4 versus loadTrack errors0, full validate exit0, agree pairs240 (RECHECK-P1-01). Counts need not be numerically equal for track groups or exclusion-derived missing rows; acceptance contradiction is established by actual disagreeing acceptance.

Shipped 23/23; the shipped last three use stubs, independently replaced here by complete actual b16 sources and validators. First b14 B01 defects3/exit1, B02 defects0/exit0 with state notice; final b16 A01/A02/B01/B02 clean. All 16 captured b2-b16 batch variants have identical full validate logs/exits across old/new commits. Manual-only output correction instruction present at the target.
Both requested artifacts, two new P1 findings, zero new P0, and one-line b17 hold decision recorded. Review pass means completed verification, not all acceptance assertions satisfied.

findings.title: loadTrack accepts rows assigned to the wrong chunk while checkChunk rejects them
findings.trigger: Exchange the first valid A01 and A02 rows, preserving all 40 IDs exactly once and every row field.
findings.impact: A chunk validation failure is not enforced at combination. The documented per-chunk ownership contract can be bypassed by full-track validation/agreement. Existing loader omission becomes explicit divergence with the new checker; not evidence of trackExcluded leakage.
findings.recommendation: Share structured chunk ownership/missing checks with loadTrack, enforce them before accepting rows, and cover a real runner swap counterexample.

findings.title: Foreign chunk IDs remain visible in reason text despite filtered affected-ID lists
findings.trigger: Give two A01 rows and one A02 row the same not_observable reason beginning with the ID of a different A01 row; retain valid complete row data.
findings.impact: The own-ID list is filtered, but e.text is interpolated verbatim. The old runner redacted foreign IDs throughout the message. The new runner leaks a known foreign ID even without misplaced rows; wrong-chunk row errors also print foreign IDs directly.
findings.recommendation: Redact all known foreign IDs from every rendered diagnostic, including reason snippets, row/chunk messages and wrong-chunk-ID diagnostics, while preserving structured membership internally.
